## YouTube Channel Analytics (Easy)

1. Get a free API key: console.cloud.google.com > enable **YouTube Data API v3** > Credentials > Create API key.
2. Open the **Config** node and paste your key and the channel handle (e.g. `@MrBeast`).
3. Click **Execute workflow**. Open the last node and read the `report` field.

No other credentials needed. Remove your API key before sharing this workflow.
